body:
More on Ice Golem from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Golem, Ice (3pp)" but are not part of the Ice Golem entry, which is unchanged.

Lightning-based effects slow an ice golem (as the spell) for 2d6 rounds. Cold-based effects heal all of its lost hit points.

ECOLOGY

Environment any
Organization solitary
Treasure none

The ice golem is a humanoid formed of roughly chiseled ice, standing 10 feet tall and weighing around 800 pounds. Ice golems at rest appear to be normal ice sculptures and are often mistaken as such (DC 20 Perception check to notice the creature is alive).

An ice golem usually opens combat with its breath weapon. An ice golem never uses weapons or wears armor, preferring to attack with its powerful fists. Fire is an effective means of combating these creatures.
